items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: I think you know the story. Many years ago, Jascha Heifetz went to hear Joe Venuti play.

ctx.x: Well there’s something to be said for the classic music of that day. It has lasted.

Oh, I know what I wanted to say. Joe Venuti is on there. I think you know the story. Many years ago, Jascha Heifetz went to hear Joe Venuti play. And Jascha told Venuti, he says, “if you had gone in to be a concert violinist, you would have been one of the greatest.” Because he had the time and he had the intonation. You notice about Joe? You have the record. He does “How High the Moon,” and he does “Autumn Leaves.” His intonation is beautiful.
